mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion and dehydration may potentiate cholinergic effects of rivastigmine, increasing vagomimetic adverse effects; rivastigmine's cholinomimetic activity may enhance torsemide-induced hypotension.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium), blood pressure, and heart rate regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider baseline ECG given additive cardiac effects.
